# Prism

> Prism is a Python CLI and library for statically scanning Ansible roles, collections, and repositories to generate README, runbook, and machine-readable documentation.

Use this file as the entry point for LLM context loading. Start with the current docs home and the public API/CLI surfaces, then drill into the scanner packages that own runtime behavior.

Prism uses static file analysis, so runtime-only Ansible behavior may remain unresolved and is intentionally reported as uncertain metadata.

## Documentation

- [Docs Home](docs/README.md): Primary documentation index for users, operators, and maintainers.
- [Site Index](docs/index.md): High-level navigation and role-based reading paths.
- [User Guide](docs/user-guide.md): Day-to-day CLI workflows and contract-oriented usage.
- [DevOps Guide](docs/devops-guide.md): CI, policy, and operational rollout patterns.
- [Policy Inputs and Audit Rules](docs/feedback-integration.md): Replacement for the retired learn-feedback path using native flags, audit rules, and JSON governance flows.
- [Pure Execution Architecture](docs/pure-execution-architecture.md): Current scanner runtime ownership model and plugin-routing architecture.
- [Release Notes](docs/changelog.md): Current user-facing release summary.

## Developer Documentation

- [Developer Docs Index](docs/dev_docs/README.md): Engineering reference index for architecture, maintenance, and governance.
- [Architecture](docs/dev_docs/architecture.md): Current package boundaries, runtime flow, and ownership rules.
- [Package Capabilities](docs/dev_docs/package-capabilities.md): Capability ownership by public surface and internal package.
- [CLI Targets](docs/dev_docs/cli-targets.md): Intent and output strategy for `role`, `collection`, `repo`, and `completion`.
- [Static Analysis Scope](docs/dev_docs/static-analysis-scope.md): In-scope guarantees and explicit non-goals.
- [Dependency Hygiene](docs/dev_docs/dependency-hygiene.md): Current dependency-audit workflow and local command path.

## Core Interfaces

- [CLI Entrypoint](src/prism/cli.py): Command interface (`prism role`, `prism collection`, `prism repo`, `prism completion`).
- [Public API](src/prism/api.py): Stable programmatic entry points (`scan_role`, `scan_repo`, `scan_collection`).
- [Repo Services](src/prism/repo_services.py): Shared repository-intake and repo-scan helpers used by API and CLI flows.
- [Scan Request Canonicalization](src/prism/scanner_core/scan_request.py): Canonical option shaping before runtime execution begins.
- [Kernel Routing](src/prism/scanner_kernel/plugin_name_resolver.py): Deterministic plugin selection order and route preflight carrier types.
- [Kernel Orchestrator](src/prism/scanner_kernel/orchestrator.py): Routing, plugin invocation, and strict/non-strict runtime handling.
- [Ansible Plugin Bundle](src/prism/scanner_plugins/ansible/__init__.py): Canonical Ansible platform execution bundle and scan-pipeline plugin.
- [Audit Rule Contracts](src/prism/scanner_config/audit_rules.py): Policy-as-Code rule, violation, and report types.
- [Output Layer](src/prism/scanner_io/output.py): Output format selection and write behavior.

## Configuration and Tooling

- [Project Metadata](pyproject.toml): Package metadata, dependencies, and console script registration.
- [Tox Configuration](tox.ini): Test and coverage execution environments.
- [Tool Configuration](setup.cfg): Pytest/coverage and lint-related settings.
- [Development Requirements](requirements-dev.txt): Additional dependencies for local development.
- [Workflow: Prism Docs](.github/workflows/prism.yml): CI job that generates docs using the subcommand CLI.
- [Workflow: Main CI](.github/workflows/default.yml): Main CI checks for tests and quality gates.
- [Workflow: Dependency Hygiene](.github/workflows/dependency-hygiene.yml): Dependency audit workflow using `pip-audit`.

- [Fixture Index](src/prism/tests/roles/README.md): Catalog of role fixtures used by scanner and rendering tests.

- [Base Mock Role](src/prism/tests/roles/base_mock_role/README.md): Minimal fixture for baseline scan behavior.
- [In-Role Config Fixture](src/prism/tests/roles/inrole_config_role/README.md): Fixture that validates `.prism.yml`-driven rendering behavior.
